# Brunch Menu for 6 on a $60 Budget

A special-feeling, low-stress brunch is easiest with one make-ahead savory, one stovetop savory, one baked sweet, and two batch drinks. This plan keeps the vegetarian and lactose-free needs covered without making separate meals.

## Menu Plan and Cost Breakdown

| Item | What it is | Est. cost |
|---|---|---:|
| Savory 1 | Veggie frittata with spinach, peppers, onion, and potatoes | $14 |
| Savory 2 | Savory breakfast toasts with smashed avocado, tomato, and everything seasoning | $12 |
| Sweet | Cinnamon-baked French toast casserole with berries | $15 |
| Drink 1 | Citrus-mint iced tea | $5 |
| Drink 2 | Orange-ginger sparkling cooler | $8 |
| Pantry / garnish buffer | Eggs, bread, butter/oil, seasoning, herbs, ice, extras | $6 |
| Total |  | **$60** |

## Brunch Game Plan for 6

### 1) Veggie Frittata
- Fits the vegetarian guest.
- Naturally lactose-free if you skip cheese or use a small dairy-free topping.
- Uses the stovetop first, then finishes in the oven.

### 2) Avocado Tomato Toasts
- Quick, fresh, and feels brunchy.
- Easy to keep dairy-free.
- Best assembled right before serving so the bread stays crisp.

### 3) Cinnamon-Baked French Toast Casserole
- Make-ahead sweet dish that serves a crowd.
- Can be baked while you prep the savory items.
- Use plant milk or regular milk depending on what you have; plant milk keeps it safe for the lactose-intolerant guest.

### 4) Citrus-Mint Iced Tea
- Light and refreshing.
- Brew early and chill.

### 5) Orange-Ginger Sparkling Cooler
- Festive, non-alcoholic, and easy to batch.
- Add sparkling water at the end so it stays fizzy.

## Prep Timeline and Serving Order

### 2 to 3 Hours Before Guests Arrive
- Start the iced tea first so it can cool.
- Prep the French toast casserole and let it soak.
- Chop vegetables for the frittata.
- Mix the orange-ginger cooler base and chill it.

### 90 Minutes Before
- Bake the French toast casserole.
- While it bakes, cook the frittata filling on the stovetop.
- Whisk eggs and pour the frittata mixture into the pan.

### 45 Minutes Before
- Move the frittata to the oven to finish.
- Slice bread for toast.
- Mash avocado and prep tomato topping.
- Set the table and drinks.

### 20 Minutes Before
- Remove French toast casserole and cover loosely.
- Pull the frittata and let it rest 5 to 10 minutes.
- Toast bread right before serving.
- Add sparkling water to the cooler.

### Serving Order
1. Put out drinks first so guests have something right away.
2. Serve fruit or a small bread basket if you have it.
3. Bring out the frittata and avocado toasts together.
4. Serve the French toast casserole last as the sweet finish.

## Shopping List

### Produce
- 1 bag spinach
- 2 bell peppers
- 1 onion
- 3–4 potatoes
- 3 avocados
- 4–5 tomatoes
- 1 lemon
- 2 oranges
- 1 piece fresh ginger
- 1 bunch mint
- 1 pint berries

### Dairy / Eggs
- 12 eggs
- Milk or oat milk
- Butter or plant-based spread

### Bread / Dry Goods
- 1 loaf sturdy bread or sourdough
- Sandwich bread or brioche for French toast
- Oats or sugar if you want to sweeten the drinks lightly
- Cinnamon
- Everything seasoning or salt and pepper

### Drinks / Pantry
- Black tea bags
- Sparkling water
- Honey or sugar
- Ice

### Optional Extras
- Fresh herbs
- Powdered sugar for the French toast
- Yogurt or dairy-free yogurt if you want a side topping

## Quick Hosting Notes

- Keep the frittata and French toast warm in a low oven if needed.
- Make the avocado toast last so it doesn’t brown.
- If you want the menu to feel more elevated, use one garnish on each dish: herbs on the frittata, sliced tomatoes on toast, and powdered sugar or berries on the French toast.

## Sources

- USDA Food Plans for budget guidance: https://www.fns.usda.gov/cnpp/usda-food-plans-cost-food-monthly-reports
- Food safety and holding temperatures: https://www.foodsafety.gov/keep-food-safe/foodkeeper-app
- Brunch planning basics: https://www.allrecipes.com/article/brunch-menu-ideas/
